stories.title: EN DIRECT - Sommet États-Unis/Chine : Donald Trump accueille Xi Jinping avec faste à la Maison-Blanche

en.title: LIVE - US/China Summit: Donald Trump welcomes Xi Jinping with ceremony at the White House
en.summary: Donald Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House. Trump stated that artificial superintelligence will be a major discussion topic, noting both countries wish to maintain the current position on the matter.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, interview d’Emmanuel Macron : suivez la prise de parole du chef de l’Etat, sur TF1 et France 2, à sept mois de l’élection présidentielle

en.title: LIVE, Emmanuel Macron interview: follow the French president's address on TF1 and France 2, seven months before the presidential election
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is being interviewed on national television following his return from the UN General Assembly. He is expected to address fuel price increases and the Russian security threat.

stories.title: «Le RN n’a tout simplement pas respecté les règles» : à Montargis, le tribunal administratif annule la victoire de l’extrême droite aux municipales

en.title: "The RN simply did not respect the rules": in Montargis, the administrative court annuls the far-right's municipal election victory
en.summary: An administrative court in Montargis has annulled the municipal election results won by the far-right party. The court found the party violated rules by widely distributing a defamatory video targeting a left-wing coalition candidate.

stories.title: Mort de Quentin Deranque à Lyon : huit nouvelles interpellations, cinq personnes mises en examen pour "association de malfaiteurs"

en.title: Death of Quentin Deranque in Lyon: eight new arrests, five people charged with "criminal conspiracy"
en.summary: Eight people have been arrested in connection with Quentin Deranque's death in Lyon. Five have been charged with criminal conspiracy, with prosecutors seeking detention for three of them.

stories.title: Assemblée générale de l'ONU : "Combien de temps allez-vous garder le silence face à Israël ?", interroge Mahmoud Abbas, le président de l'Autorité palestinienne

en.title: UN General Assembly: "How long will you remain silent on Israel?", asks Mahmoud Abbas, president of the Palestinian Authority
en.summary: The Palestinian Authority president addressed the UN General Assembly via videoconference after being denied a U.S. visa.

stories.title: Mort de Quentin Deranque à Lyon : cinq nouveaux militants d’ultragauche mis en examen

en.title: Death of Quentin Deranque in Lyon: five new far-left activists charged
en.summary: Eight individuals close to the antifa movement were arrested. A total of 14 people are now under investigation in connection with the death of an identitarian activist in February.

stories.title: Le romancier Thélyson Orélien, accusé d'avoir utilisé l'IA, dénonce une "volonté" de le "faire taire"

en.title: Novelist Thélyson Orélien, accused of using AI, denounces an attempt to "silence" him
en.summary: An author accused of using AI by an anonymous account spoke at a literary festival, contesting the accusations against him.

stories.title: Mort de Quentin Deranque à Lyon : cinq nouvelles mises en examen

en.title: Death of Quentin Deranque in Lyon: five new people charged
en.summary: Five people arrested in the investigation of the far-right activist's murder in February are suspected of participating in violence but not of delivering the fatal blows.

stories.title: Municipales 2026 : la victoire du RN à Montargis annulée par le tribunal administratif

en.title: Municipal Elections 2026: RN Victory in Montargis Annulled by Administrative Court
en.summary: An administrative court has annulled the National Rally candidate's March municipal election victory in Montargis, a city of 15,000 residents previously governed by the right-wing, where he had won by 59 votes.

stories.title: Le tribunal administratif annule la victoire du RN aux municipales à Montargis, "en raison de la diffusion d'une vidéo à caractère diffamatoire avant le second tour"

en.title: Administrative Court Annuls RN Victory in Montargis Municipal Elections "Due to Circulation of Defamatory Video Before Second Round"
en.summary: An administrative court has cancelled the National Rally candidate's 59-vote victory in March's Montargis municipal election, citing the distribution of a defamatory video prior to the second round of voting.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, ONU : La politique d’Israël menace « jusqu’à la vie et l’existence » des Palestiniens, dit Mahmoud Abbas

en.title: LIVE, UN: Israeli Policy Threatens "Life and Existence" of Palestinians, Says Mahmoud Abbas
en.summary: The Palestinian Authority president, unable to obtain a visa, addressed the UN General Assembly via pre-recorded video, characterizing Israeli policy as threatening Palestinian survival and criticizing visa restrictions as unjustified punishment.

stories.title: Législatives au Maroc : la coalition sortante conserve la main malgré une forte abstention

en.title: Morocco Legislative Elections: Outgoing Coalition Maintains Control Despite High Abstention
en.summary: Morocco's outgoing political coalition has retained power in Wednesday's legislative elections, despite voter participation reaching only 38.02%, one of the lowest levels in the past two decades.

stories.title: OPINION. « Quelle place donnez-vous au droit d’auteur à l’heure de l’intelligence artificielle ? », par Cécile Rap-Veber, directrice générale de la Sacem

en.title: OPINION. "What place do you give to copyright in the age of artificial intelligence?", by Cécile Rap-Veber, CEO of Sacem
en.summary: The head of Sacem addresses candidates gathered at a presidential debate on AI in Marseille, raising questions about copyright protections in the context of artificial intelligence development.

stories.title: Rafale : Dassault anime ses relations industrielles au Portugal

en.title: Rafale: Dassault strengthens its industrial relations in Portugal
en.summary: Dassault Aviation signed an agreement with Portugal's aerospace and defense industries association on September 23 to prepare industrial groundwork for a potential Portuguese acquisition of the Rafale fighter jet.

stories.title: Des LLM aux world models, l’IA générative ouvre un nouveau front

en.title: From LLMs to world models, generative AI opens a new frontier
en.summary: Large language models are now widespread in daily and professional use, but emerging world models may overcome their limitations by predicting and simulating real-world developments.

stories.title: OPINION. « IA et création, l’autre grand enjeu du prochain quinquennat »

en.title: OPINION. "AI and creation, the other major issue of the next five-year term"
en.summary: Sacem's CEO calls on presidential candidates to address threats posed by generative AI to artists' revenues, including copyright infringement, misinformation, and cultural creation concerns ahead of the Marseille AI debate.

stories.title: Aéronautique : Thales se dote à Bordeaux d’un espace dédié à la culture du risque

en.title: Aerospace: Thales establishes dedicated risk culture space in Bordeaux
en.summary: Thales is opening a safety training facility in Bordeaux to address concerns that increased production pace and staff turnover are weakening the risk culture essential to aerospace manufacturing. The space aims to educate employees, subcontractors, and clients on aviation safety.
